description: This Dart file defines the HistoryProvider class, which manages fetching, caching, and clearing session data for display purposes in a Flutter application. It interacts with a database service and notifies listeners of data changes.

classes.name: HistoryProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages history session data, providing methods to load and clear sessions from persistent storage.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches recent sessions from the database and updates the internal list, notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all session data from the database and refreshes the in-memory list.
